svg.title: Session 1 turns chat into memory; session 2 answers from the graph alone
svg.desc: In session 1, chat messages go through LLM extraction of entities, facts and decisions, and a Cypher MERGE writes them to the memory graph, where a new item supersedes the one in its slot. In session 2, a question runs a Cypher recall of the current items and what they replaced, and the answer comes from the graph alone.
